desc:
Pantura Road Bus Simulator [PRBS] is an Indonesian driving game with detailed buses and a map based on the Pantura road. More buses will be added soon!

This game is still in heavy development. Expect bugs and performance issues.

Want to know about future updates or found a bug? Join our Community server using the social links below

Shutdown = Update
Free private servers available!

Keybinds:
WASD – Drive
H – Horn 
L – Lights
Z/X/C – Indicators
F – Engine
P – Parking Brake
Shift+P – Freecam
C/V – Camera
E/Q – Gear Shift

The Bus Won't Move? Try Shifting The Gear

Update Log:
-Bug Fixes
-8 New Bus
-Small Optimization
